children: Glenbrook Believes Better Market Strategy and Sharpened Capitalization Focus Would Create Significant Upside
MINDEN, Nev., Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Glenbrook Capital Management ("Glenbrook"), a long-time shareholder of SenesTech, Inc. (
) (the "Company") and owners of over 30% of outstanding shares of the Company, today issued the following letter.
Matthew Szot, Chairman of the Board

I am writing to advise you that Glenbrook Capital Management ("GCM" or "we") is now a significant shareholder of SenesTech, Inc. ("SenesTech" or the "Company"), with holdings representing more than 30% of the outstanding common shares. Let me start by congratulating you on the 40% topline growth in Q3 and hitting a $4 million run rate. Our substantial investment reflects our belief that constructive engagement can help strengthen the business further and create value.

For our part, GCM intends to remain a supportive long-term investor, and we have participated in every round to which we were invited, starting before and including the IPO. We may—or may not-- increase our holdings over time, opportunistically, since we believe that the Company is grossly undervalued considering the market opportunity. Our fellow shareholders have endured a recurring cycle of dilutive offerings and reverse splits. Your shareholders want to end this cycle. We will consider further investment in SenesTech, subject to mutually acceptable terms and market conditions. Our primary goal, however, is to minimize equity dilution, and all efforts should be addressed to this end going forward. We believe that getting traction in the business is the right place to start.

As backers of the Company since before the IPO, we have been frustrated by the degree to which the sales have lagged the game-changing nature of SenesTech products. The market is there, we all know it, so how do we better communicate with and educate potential users? Because we want to help address this conundrum we retained (at our expense) the internationally recognized branding and marketing strategy firm, Sandstrom Partners ("Sandstrom"). Having completed their exhaustive analysis of the Company's business, they are ready to share with you their conclusions and advice. If you retain them for SenesTech, this will extend to ensuring that your recently heralded Amazon sales advances continue. For example, messaging purchasers so that they fully understand how to effectively use both Evolve and ContraPest.

We think a sharpened focus on capital discipline can benefit SenesTech and all of its shareholders. We supported and voted in favor of the recent increase in the Company's stock option plan. We encourage the Company to consider selective use of equity-based compensation in place of cash compensation. Speaking as a shareholder, we believe the optics for the Company would be significantly stronger if equity was awarded as compensation in lieu of cash. A thoughtful approach, with performance conditions and attention to avoiding dilution, could conserve cash while more closely aligning the interests of the Board with shareholders.

Our desire is to work cooperatively with the Board and management team on practical measures designed to improve the Company's financial position and support operating priorities. We look forward to engaging directly in the near future.
